sites.name: Palenque
sites.what: Maya city in the Chiapas rainforest, run as an archaeological zone by INAH inside Palenque National Park.

access.opening: Daily 8 am to 5 pm, last entry 4 pm
access.tickets: MXN 210 for foreign visitors (MXN 105 for nationals and residents of Mexico); the separate national park fee charged by CONANP is not included
